claims_to_verify: Myth 1: Vispute et al., J Strength Cond Res 2011;25(9):2559-64 — 6 weeks of ab training did not reduce abdominal fat (spot reduction).
Myth 2: 'muscle confusion' is a marketing term; progressive overload is the accepted driver of growth.
Myth 3: Refalo et al., Sports Med 2023;53(3):649-665 — no clear hypertrophy advantage of training to failure. '1-3 reps short' is common coaching guidance.
Myth 4: general physiology; deliberately no numbers.
Myth 5: Schoenfeld & Contreras, Strength Cond J 2013;35(5):16-21 — soreness is not a valid indicator of muscular adaptation.
Myth 6: general consensus that diet, sleep and training matter far more than supplements; no product named.
